card.name: Linking words before monitored outcomes
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, of, by, from, with) right after monitoring, guidance, or sign-type words, just before the thing being watched for or judged. Appears in drug-label warnings and monitoring advice.

modes.label: The phrase "monitor for"
modes.description: "for" after monitoring or monitor, introducing the effect to watch.
modes.example: If praziquantel is necessary immediately, increase monitoring<< for>> reduced anthelmintic efficacy associated with

modes.label: The phrase "sign or chance of"
modes.description: "of" after sign, chance or risk, before an outcome such as treatment failure.
modes.example: This is rarely a sign<< of>> treatment failure and is not an indication for

modes.label: The phrase "guided or determined by"
modes.description: "by" after guided or determined, before the criterion used for decisions.
modes.example: The duration of therapy should be guided<< by>> the severity and site of the infection and
